issues.evidence: Tibetan རྡོ་རྗེ་གཅོད་པའི་སྙིང་པོ་འདི་ is a single term (locked: वज्रच्छेदिका-हृदय; སྙིང་པོ alone = सार). The translation applies both renderings to the one word སྙིང་པོ, yielding 'the essence of the Vajracchedikā-heart', which adds a second noun the Tibetan does not have (Chone Drakpa Shedrub 3-2 likewise has the single སྙིང་པོ). English: 'this essence of the Diamond Cutter'.
